notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). No hardware was attached and native.py was never imported or run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names helper PythonObjectDriver; the package is a decorated direct Driver over owon_ps:OwonPowerSupply (the card decision direct-driver is unchanged). A direct Driver expresses the boolean output-state write, the e-stop and the no-input safe-state action without a PythonObjectBridge command table; no wire syntax was changed. The four numeric writes (voltage_setpoint, current_setpoint, voltage_limit, current_limit) are Limit.operator_required: the clone states no complete range for the generic class, only the 1 V and 100 mA minima in code comments at owon_ps.py:77 and owon_ps.py:92 and the model-specific SPE3051 values in example.py:4. Without an operator overlay every one is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. site-limits.example.json is an example overlay for that model (0-30 V, 0-5 A, limits 1-30 V and 0.1-5 A), not a statement about an installed unit; it only narrows and must be replaced. The three PDFs under _pdf/ were not cited because no page was read; every Fact and Limit cites a text file or a code line of the clone. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording: its start values and replies are placeholders; get_all_parametrs returns a raw string and the driver does not parse it; measured voltage, current and power are modeled from the fake state. The candidate classes cap.measure.voltage.v1 and cap.measure.current.v1 were not bound: their resource kinds are instrument.dmm/instrument.smu/sensor and this device is a source; voltage, current and power are served as read state and cap.device.configure.v1 serves the writes. At R1 the loader does not refuse the hardware backend of this unreviewed model-written package, so nothing mechanical prevents hardware use: a human must review the package before anyone passes --allow-hardware. The software e-stop and the safe-state action both send OUTPut OFF; no independent hardware e-stop is cited or claimed. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
